name: ImageCopy
description: Creates a new image by copying a rectangular area from the source image. If destination coordinates are provided, the copied area is also drawn at the new location in the resulting image.
syntax: ImageCopy( any image, number x, number y, number width, number height, [number dx], [number dy] )

params.name: image
params.description: The image on which this operation is performed.

params.name: x
params.description: The x coordinate of the source rectangle.

params.name: y
params.description: The y coordinate of the source rectangle.

params.name: width
params.description: The width of the source rectangle.

params.name: height
params.description: The height of the source rectangle.

params.name: dx
params.description: The x coordinate of the destination rectangle.

params.name: dy
params.description: The y coordinate of the destination rectangle.
